title: ETHGlobal Mumbai
description: ETHGlobal's in-person hackathon in Mumbai, November 5 to 7, 2026. Hackers apply to attend, stake a small amount of ETH to confirm (returned after submitting), build in teams of up to 5, and submit through the Hacker Dashboard. 12 partner prizes are listed so far.
reward: $141,000 in prizes across the 12 partner prizes listed on Oct 20, 2026 (World's prize details are still to come)
summary: $141K in prizes · in person · submit by Nov 7, 9:00 AM IST
setup: apply to attend by Nov 3 and get accepted
stake a small amount of ETH
rules: In person in Mumbai, November 5 to 7, 2026. Hacker applications close November 3 at 11:59 PM IST; each team member must be accepted and stake individually. Teams of up to 5.
Submissions are due Saturday, November 7, 2026 at 9:00 AM IST, through the Hacker Dashboard. Late submissions are not accepted.
Classic track: all project work must begin after the hackathon starts. Projects built before the event may still take part but don't qualify for partner prizes or the Finalist category.

Continuity tracks (Extend Open Source, Ship a Feature): you may build on an existing codebase; document the pre-existing work and add new features built during the hackathon. Partner prize eligibility may vary by partner.
Use version control: large single commits or missing histories may be disqualified.
AI tools are allowed: document where and how they were used; projects built entirely by AI may not be eligible for partner prizes or finalist consideration.
Select up to 3 partner prizes on the last step of the submission form.
The stake is returned within about 4 weeks after the event to hackers who submitted a project.

submission_requirements.label: How it's made
submission_requirements.description: Document where and how AI tools were used, and keep any spec files and prompts in the repo.

submission_requirements.label: GitHub repository
submission_requirements.description: A repo (or Figma files or equivalent) proving the work was done during the hackathon, with a commit history; say what is new and what is reused.

submission_requirements.label: Demo video
submission_requirements.description: Optional but strongly encouraged: 2 to 4 minutes, at least 720p, no sped-up footage, no AI voiceover.

submission_requirements.label: Partner prizes
submission_requirements.description: On the last step, select up to 3 partner prizes, and explain for each how you used the partner's tools.
